items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1978-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] A little train. Years ago, the musicians used to have a soft joke. They'd say, can you read Yabba not enough to hurt my plane? [INTERVIEWEE] That was the attitude of a lot of real old timers.

ctx.x: A little later on, I had a few, a couple of months. Not a few. Which didn't work out too well. But that's about the extent of a couple of months.
